text: Ok so. The guy from woodstock 👀
The one from the bar??
Yes that one
Ok tell me everything. Did he call or did you have to chase
He called. We got food and then back to mine and he was very confident about everything which I did not expect from someone who spent 40 mins on the cocktail menu
Lol so he talked a big game
He talked a big game then took about four minutes to figure out what I wanted and decided he was the expert anyway 😂
Classic
Also he kept asking if I was ok every 30 seconds which was sweet for a bit and then just killed the mood
That's the worst. People who check in like they're doing a survey
EXACTLY. I wanted to say just stop talking and see what happens
Did you say it
No but I did grab his hand and put it where I wanted it so
Ok that's a sentence I did not need before supper
You asked 😂
Fair. And the morning after? Was he weird
He made me coffee then asked my opinion on his playlist for 20 min. Not a bad guy just a bit much
A bit much is most guys
True. Are you going to tell me about yours or are we still on mine
Mine is boring this month. Was at the braai at Mpho's, nothing happened. Some guy from the office keeps messaging me about a spreadsheet and it's getting weird
Weird how
He's been sending me "quick question" messages at 11pm for two weeks and the questions are not quick
That's a hard no from me
I'm not dating him kate he's an auditor
Even worse 😂
Did you watch the match
The second half. They were terrible for 60 min and then suddenly not
That's the most accurate description of my last two relationships
You're going to have to explain that one
Not tonight
Ok. Night
He texted me this morning. A whole paragraph about the playlist
What paragraph
Something about the bridge on track 6 "changing his whole approach to the record." Then he asked if I'd come to a gig next month
Did you say yes
I said I'd think about it. I'm thinking about it as a no
Good. Keep it a no until he earns a yes
Going in, Mrs D is already at the counter wanting her blood pressure refill and asking if you're still single
Tell her yes and that I'm still an accountant so she can stop asking
Auditor sent another one. "Quick question re: Q3 accruals" at 6:12am. It's not quick
Reply with one word and see how he takes it
I wrote "Monday." He replied with four paragraphs
😂 ok it's officially a problem
Lunch. A man just asked me for something for his cough that was clearly for his wife's cough. Not my problem
Did you give it to him
Obviously not. I told him to take her to the doctor
So are you going to explain the match thing or is that a tomorrow conversation
Tomorrow. I need wine for it
Ok. I'll bring wine
You'll bring the cheap one and we both know it
It's a good cheap one
[link: playlist]
Don't open it
Too late. There's a track called "Blue Hour (Demo)" with a voice memo at the start where he laughs for 40 seconds
That's the worst thing you've ever sent me
You asked
Ok night
Night x
Did he send anything else or is that it for the morning
Voice note. 2 min. About the bridge again
Ok that's a no then
Still a no 😂
Going in. Mrs D is already at the counter
Tell her I'm still single and still an accountant
Already did. She said accountants are the worst and that you'd understand
She's not wrong
[photo: spreadsheet with one yellow cell]
Is the cell actually wrong
No. He just likes yellow
😂 Respect
Shift ends 5. Still on for tonight or do you want to do it another time
Still on. Leaving work at 6 so maybe 7
Ok. I'm not cooking
Obviously. I'm bringing the good cheap one
Lol
Door's open. Wine glasses are the good ones so don't break them
Home. Took a glass of the cheap one home by accident
Told you it was a good cheap one
Don't. I'm not ready to admit it on this day
Ok. Night. Go to sleep, you have the auditor at 7
He's not even awake that early
